Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign using Google Ads tracking templates to create convincing Webex software search ads that redirect users to malware distribution sites
Fake Webex installer MSI that runs PowerShell commands to install BatLoader malware
BatLoader fetches, decrypts, and executes DanaBot malware payload
DanaBot is a modular banking trojan capable of stealing passwords, taking screenshots, loading ransomware modules, masking malicious C2 traffic, and providing HVNC access
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running fake Webex installer
Attack Vector: Malicious Google Ads impersonating Webex download portal with real Webex logo and URL
Redirects via Firebase URL tracking template to malicious domains filtering out researchers
Redirection chain leading to malware-dropping site
Indicators of Compromise: Use of PowerShell commands in installer
